items.snippet_en: Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed in the lunar south pole region on August 23, 2023, making India the first nation to achieve a soft landing in that area. India is the fourth country to land on the Moon.

Al Jazeera reported on August 23, 2023, that India could become the first nation to land a spacecraft on the Moon's south pole, with Chandrayaan-3 scheduled to touch down near the little-explored lunar south pole.

ISRO posted that India's Chandrayaan-3 mission made history on August 23, 2023, by achieving a successful soft landing near the Moon's south pole, a region never explored this closely before. India became the first to successfully touch down in the lunar south polar region.

Pacific Space Center published that Chandrayaan-3 touched down at the lunar south pole on August 23, 2023, marking a historic milestone for India and human space exploration as a never-before visited region of the Moon.

home.blog stated that India's Moon mission became the first to land in the lunar south pole region on August 23, 2023. India joined the US, the former Soviet Union, and China in achieving a soft landing on the Moon.

The Guardian reported that India became the first country to successfully land a spacecraft near the south pole of the Moon. Sreedhara Panicker Somanath, chair of ISRO, said "India is on the moon" after the Vikram lander touched down.
